signals.title_or_quote: Admin dashboard: monitor sync, AI-enrich, and app-distribution health per user
signals.why_relevant: Needs admin dashboard for monitoring, aligns with auto-generated UI from schema
signals.drafted_reply: For monitoring sync and app health per user, generating a dashboard from your Postgres schema could save time. stackbuilt auto-generates CRUD interfaces from Postgres and supports custom views. I'm the builder. {APP_URL}.

rescore.why: The thread is a GitHub issue scoping an admin monitoring dashboard for an existing app's internal health metrics, and the author has already recommended Metabase as the solution — they are not shopping for an internal tool builder.

signals.title_or_quote: Backup and restore for the estate, visible in the admin panel
signals.why_relevant: Requests admin panel visibility for backup/restore, a CRUD use case
signals.drafted_reply: Exposing backup and restore in an admin panel is a common need. If you're using Postgres, tools like stackbuilt can generate that UI directly from your schema. Self-hosted, so data stays internal. I'm the builder. {APP_URL}.

rescore.why: The thread is a GitHub issue describing a custom-built backup and restore system for a multi-database estate, not a request for an internal tool builder or admin panel scaffolding solution.

signals.title_or_quote: Looking for a Postgres admin panel solution with remote team access

signals.drafted_reply: A Postgres-backed admin panel with remote access can be scaffolded quickly if you self-host. stackbuilt generates one from your schema and includes role-based access. Free for self-hosted use. I'm the builder. {APP_URL}.
